TROPICAL CYCLONE ADVISORY NO. 02 FOR NORTH INDIAN OCEAN (THE BAY OF
BENGAL AND ARABIAN SEA) ISSUED AT 1600 UTC OF 01.11.2026 BASED ON 1200 UTC
OF 01.11.2026
Sub: Cyclonic Storm “Murasu” [Pronunciation: Murasu] over Southwest & adjoining Westcentral
Bay of Bengal.
The Cyclonic Storm “Murasu” [Pronunciation: Murasu]” over Southwest & adjoining Westcentral Bay of
Bengal moved west-northwestwards with speed of 25 kmph during past 6 hours and lay centered at 1200
UTC of today, the 01st November, 2026 over the same region near Latitude 12.7°N and Longitude 84.1°E,
about 420 km east-southeast of Chennai (Tamil Nadu, 43279), 490 km east-southeast of Nellore (Andhra
Pradesh, 43245), 500 km southeast of Machilipatnam (Andhra Pradesh, 43185), 510 east-southeast of
Kavali (Andhra Pradesh, 43243), 530 km southeast of Ongole (Andhra Pradesh, 43221) and 560 km south-
southeast of Vishakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh, 43149).
It is very likely to move west-northwestwards and intensify further into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over
Westcentral Bay of Bengal around 2100 UTC of 1nd November. Thereafter, it is very likely to move
northwestwards and cross south Andhra Pradesh coast as a Severe Cyclonic Storm with wind speed of
100 to 110 kmph gusting 120 kmph between Nellore (Andhra Pradesh, 43245) and Narsapur (Andhra
Pradesh, 43187) close to Ongole during 1800-2200 UTC of 2rd November, 2026.
